edges.description: Defective fibrillin microfibrils fail to properly sequester latent TGF-beta complexes.
Loss of normal fibrillin scaffold destabilizes elastic fiber architecture and ECM integrity.
Altered fibrillin-integrin interactions impair mechanosensing in load-bearing connective tissues.
Excess SMAD signaling increases protease activity and maladaptive ECM turnover.
Persistent TGF-beta activity accelerates medial degeneration and progressive root dilation.
Dysregulated growth factor signaling contributes to long bone overgrowth.
Abnormal connective tissue growth signaling contributes to elongated digits.
Elastic fiber fragmentation and collagen disarray weaken the aortic wall.
Connective tissue degeneration in valve leaflets promotes prolapse.
Weak zonular microfibrils predispose to lens displacement.
Ligamentous laxity and vertebral connective tissue weakness promote spinal curvature.
Fragile connective tissue in lung apices increases risk of spontaneous pneumothorax.
Fibrillin-1 deficiency and medial weakness affect the great vessels beyond the aorta, dilating the main pulmonary artery.
Weak ocular microfibrils, axial globe elongation, and zonular instability predispose to retinal detachment.
Weakened dural connective tissue stretches under chronic cerebrospinal-fluid pulsation, producing lumbosacral dural ectasia.
Maladaptive vascular smooth muscle responses to pulsatile stress accelerate root enlargement.
Inflammatory ECM damage and smooth muscle dysfunction increase risk of acute intimal tearing.
Oxidative injury amplifies wall fragility and susceptibility to dissection in advanced disease.
Progressive dilation weakens the aortic wall, predisposing to acute dissection.
Progressive myxomatous leaflet degeneration and prolapse render the mitral valve incompetent, producing mitral regurgitation.

The first protective link in this backfill, and the direction is the point: the exposure is the restriction itself, so what it does is prevent rather than cause. It targets the dissection phenotype because that is the event restriction is meant to avert, and the intervening step is the acute rise in blood pressure and wall stress that this entry models as impaired mechanotransduction. Graded partial throughout, because the guideline item states the intention of the restriction rather than a measured reduction. One export caveat is worth recording here rather than leaving for someone to rediscover: the exposure is named for the restriction, but the KGX exporter maps it to an exposure-to-strenuous-exercise term, so a protective predicate on this link inverts on export and reads as strenuous exercise being protective. The problem predates this link, since the free-text effect already matched, but the structured predicate is now the authoritative path. Tracked as issue #2656.

edges.description: The complementary half of activity modification, and the better-evidenced of the two protective links: this one has an intervention. Patients instructed to walk ten thousand steps a day had a significantly lower aortic root Z score than controls, which measures the outcome this node holds rather than an intention. Held simultaneously with the restriction link by design, since what is restricted is exercise intensity and type rather than physical activity itself.
